（4）助詞的機能及表現法。

課程綱要.課程目標: 1.學習利用土壤力學的理論，掌握靜止土壓力、主動及被動土壓力的概念，進行擋土 結構的設計。 2.了解淺基礎及深基礎的力傳遞方式及計算承載力的方法，並介紹不同基礎的施工方 法。 3. 結合材料力學及鋼筋混凝土的知識，來學習基本的基礎設計程序及不同基礎型式的 施工方法。 4. 認識邊坡破壞類型與機制，學習邊坡穩定分析方法與補強技術。 5. 學習地盤調查的各種方法與實務。

1.土壤剪力強度回顧

3.淺基礎承載力理論及設計
4 邊坡穩定設計
5.地下探查
6.深基礎承載力理論及設計

課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程欲利用專案導向學習與其他多元方法，期提升學生對流體力學的興趣，並探索自己是否適合流體力學相關的職場。課程當中將透過物理理論教授、 研發工作體驗、飲食品味及職場經驗分享來增進同學對流體力學相關學科的學習動機，也刺激同學思考個人的職涯規劃及學習團隊合作。本課程亦設計多元化評量，包含團體的實務專案成績，希望透過不同角度的流體力學體驗，最終協助科學教育之推動。
課程綱要.授課內容:
1. 生活中各樣流體力學的介紹 (動漫, 甜點, 咖啡, 釀造, 航海, 賽車, 棒球, 生理學, 戰機)
2. 預計演講: 戰鬥直升機飛行員, 戰機飛行員, 帆船設計師, 短片製作師, 戰機設計工程師, 民航機師.
3. 工程實作競賽: 飛機及船體製作
4. 生活實作競賽: 咖啡特調, 飲料開發
5. 科普短片製作
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1. 天文學家的咖啡物理學, Jonathan Gagné, 方言文化 2. 飛機的構造與飛行原理, 中村寬治, 知的 3. Stephenson, T. (2016). The Curious Bartender‘s Gin Palace. Ryland Peters ＆ Small. 4. 葡萄酒全書, 林裕森, 積木文化 5. Darrigol, O. (2005). Worlds of flow: A history of hydrodynamics from the Bernoullis to Prandtl. Oxford University Press.
課程綱要.授課方式: 講授 研討 實習/實驗
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 1. 飛機/船體製作分析報告 30％ 2. 飛機/船體比賽成果 10％ 3. 流體力學科普短片製做30％ 4. 期中考(英文)測驗 10％ 5. 計算作業 10% 6. 團隊與課堂參與度 10％

課程綱要.課程領域: 專業基礎學科 、 工程實務與應用

課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程主要對原子尺度下模擬之方法，亦可稱為分子動力學，作一介紹。 當尺度由巨觀逐步降至介觀甚至微觀時，材料的特性與力學行為將有極大的差異，而前述之特性或行為於微觀尺度下極不易由實驗方法而瞭解。為了能深入瞭解材料在微觀尺度下之特性，能將模擬尺度降至飛秒(femtosecond)與埃米(angstrom)的分子動力學便於數十年前起應蘊而生。
課程綱要.授課內容:
1.古典力學複習
2.蒙地卡羅方法
3.分子動力學介紹(含程式)：
a.勢能函數、原子間作用力計算
b.運動方程式
c.初始條件
4.分子動力學模擬(含程式)
a.初始條件與隨機數
b.週期性邊界
c.原子路徑之時間積分數值方法
d.範例：氣體擴散
5.分子動力學開源軟體LAMMPS介紹與實作
6.後處理影像處理軟體OVITO介紹
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1. 授課教師準備的講義 2. M. P. Allen and D. J. Tildesley, Computer Simulation of Liquids (Oxford, 1987). 3. D. Frenkel and B. Smit, Understanding Molecular Simulations: From Algorithms to Applications (Academic Press, San Diego, 2002). 4. M. E. Tuckerman, Statistical Mechanics: Theory and Molecular Simulation (Oxford, 2010).

課程綱要.課程目標: This course offers an introduction to finite element (FE) methods applied as applied to (initial) boundary value problems in engineering. Throughout the course, the FE method will be applied to transient and steady-state heat conduction, and elastostatics for continua. Finite element analysis of reticulated structures will also be discussed. MATLAB programming will be used to practice the calculation of common elements.
課程綱要.授課內容:
The class is designed to cover basic theory and demonstration of concept. Solved example problems and homework assignments will reinforce the materials covered during lectures. The tentative list of topics to be covered is listed below and closely follows chapters in the textbook. The schedule is subjected to change depending on time constraints. The course will occasionally utilize MATLAB when working on example problem and assignments. MATLAB access is provided through NCU computer center to all enrolled students or can be used in the computer office of the civil engineering department.
Handouts, assignments, homework solutions, etc., will be provided through the course web page. Bi-weekly problem sets will be assigned as shown below. These assignments are designed to cement your basic understanding of the principles covered in class. Due to limited lecture time, some ideas and applications may be introduced in the homework assignments.
Course Topics
Week 1 – Week 3:
- Math preliminaries: Vectors, tensors, vector calculus, grad, div, divergence theorem, summation convention, matrix algebra
- Boundary value problems in Elasticity
Week 4 – Week 9:
- Ritz and Galerkin methods
- FE method for 1D problems: weak (variational) forms, shape functions, stiffness matrix, global assembly, boundary conditions, node numbering, the isoparametric concept
- Principle of virtual work
- Computer implementation
- Midterm exam
Week 10 – Week 17:
- FE method for multi-dimensional problem: 2D heat conduction, isoparametric concept, element shape functions
- 2D/3D linear elasticity
- Numerical integration: Gauss quadrature, element stiffness matrix, load vectors, stabilized conforming nodal integration
- Computer implementation
Week 18 (depends on schedule):
- Computer implementation
- Review of contents
- Final exam
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Hughes TJR, The Finite Element Method: Linear Static and Dynamic Finite Element Analysis, Dover 2000 (recommended) Hjelmstad KD, Fundamentals of Structural Mechanics, 2nd ed., Springer, 2005 (recommended)
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Homework (30％) Midterm Exam (35％) Final Exam (35％)

課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Modeling and Identification of Dynamic Systems
課程綱要.課程目標: This course provides an in-depth exploration of techniques for modeling and identifying dynamic systems, with a focus on understanding the underlying physical principles and mathematical representations. The course covers a range of methods for developing models of dynamic systems from first principles and experimental data, emphasizing both theoretical and practical aspects. Course Objectives: To understand the principles of dynamic system modeling. To learn various methods for identifying dynamic systems from experimental data. To apply modeling and identification techniques to real-world systems. To develop skills in using computational tools for system modeling and identification.
課程綱要.授課內容:
Introduction to Dynamic Systems:
Overview of dynamic systems and their importance.
Classification of dynamic systems (linear vs. nonlinear, time-invariant vs. time-variant).
Basic concepts in system dynamics (state, input, output, transfer function).
Mathematical Modeling of Dynamic Systems:
Derivation of models from first principles (mechanical, electrical, thermal, and fluid systems).
Linearization of nonlinear systems.
State-space representation and transfer function models.
Block diagrams and signal flow graphs.
System Identification Techniques:
Time-domain methods (e.g., least squares, Kalman filtering).
Frequency-domain methods (e.g., spectral analysis, Bode plots).
Parametric vs. non-parametric identification methods.
Model validation and selection criteria.
Stochastic Modeling and System Identification:
Introduction to stochastic processes in dynamic systems.
Identification of systems with noise and disturbances.
Maximum likelihood estimation and other statistical methods.
Computational Tools for System Modeling and Identification:
MATLAB/Simulink for system modeling and identification.
Data acquisition and processing techniques.
Application of software tools to real-world problems.
Case Studies and Applications:
Application of modeling and identification techniques in engineering systems (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, automotive).
Case studies of real-world systems and their identification.
Group projects focusing on modeling and identification of a specific dynamic system.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Ljung, L. “System Identification: Theory for the User.“ Prentice Hall, 1999. Ogata, K. “System Dynamics.“ Prentice Hall, 2014. Franklin, G. F., Powell, J. D., and Emami-Naeini, A. “Feedback Control of Dynamic Systems.“ Pearson, 2019.

課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程主要目的為將遙測影像處理與分析常用的原理及技巧系統性地介紹給學生，以培養學生日後使用各種遙測資料進行各種應用的能力。課程內容包括遙測影像特性與格式介紹、影像校正、增顯、轉換、以及各種影像特徵萃取及分類等分析。
課程綱要.授課內容:
本課程主要目的為將遙測影像處理與分析常用的原理及技巧系統性地介紹給學生，以培養學生日後使用各種遙測資料進行各種應用的能力。課程內容包括遙測影像特性與格式介紹、影像校正、增顯、轉換、以及各種影像特徵萃取及分類等分析。(英文授課)
Note: this course may be taught in English!
The objective of this course is to provide insight into the concepts and techniques of remote sensing image processing and analysis. Students are expected to learn the knowledge and ability to process and analyze remotely-sensed digital images for assorted applications from class lectures, discussions and laboratory exercises. Topics of the course include remote sensing image characteristics and formats, image corrections, spatial and spectral enhancement, image transformation, feature extraction, and image classification. Although programming issues will be occasionally dealt with, this course is primarily intended for users of image analysis software rather than programmers. Nonetheless, programming knowledge and experience is definitely a plus. Other helpful prerequisites include vector and matrix mathematics, probability and multivariate statistics.
Course Outlines:
1.Introduction
2.Image characteristics and formats
3.Radiometric corrections
4.Geometric corrections
5.Image enhancement (point and region operations)
6.Image Transformations
7.Feature extraction (spectral, spatial, and temporal)
8.Image classification

課程綱要.課程目標: This course focuses on deep learning methods. Students will integrate and design applications for building-related decision problems, and will be familiar with how artificial intelligence can be combined with BIM to produce practical applications. When a building has a complete BIM model, it can be said to have a large amount of geometry, material and other data, which should be suitable for the application of deep learning methods for further analysis. This course has three main goals: the first is to teach deep learning methods, the second is to design and integrate these techniques, and the third is to appropriately apply them to the BIM domain.
課程綱要.授課內容:
This course will introduce programming skills in deep learning (DL, more) and building information modeling (BIM, less), using Python, with a special focus on TensorFlow (more) and PyTorch (less). The class will involve lectures, lab sessions, class discussions, homework assignments, group projects, and student presentations. By taking this class you will be able to:
(1) Understand the fundamentals of DL.
(2) Demonstrate how DL and TensorFlow can be used to support decision-making processes for various problems.
(3) Learn DL techniques such as data classification, prediction, Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), and Large Language Model (LLM).
(4) Recognize the analysis, design, implementation, and verification/validation issues of DL programs.
(5) Analyze, evaluate, and recommend DL techniques for various project stakeholders in BIM domains.
Course objectives will be refined as the course evolves. Each student will therefore be given the opportunity to influence the direction of the course.

課程綱要.課程目標: 1. 建立都市防災整體觀念：使學生理解都市防災的核心元素，包括基礎設施韌性、社區防災能力、公共資源配置與應變系統運作，培養全盤性思維。 2. 掌握都市防災理論與應用方法：介紹都市災害風險管理、韌性城市（Resilient City）、安全城市（Safe City）等國內外理論框架與實務操作模式，能夠將理論與在地情境結合。 3. 分析都市災害特性與衝擊：探討地震、洪水、颱風、火災、熱浪等在都市環境中的成因、傳導機制與衝擊，並評估都市空間脆弱性與風險熱區。 4. 理解國際都市防災趨勢：掌握國際都市防災策略與框架，如聯合國永續發展目標（SDGs）、仙台減災綱領（Sendai Framework）、C40城市氣候領導聯盟等，並評估其對本地都市防災的啟示。 5. 評估氣候變遷對都市的挑戰：認識氣候變遷帶來的複合型與極端氣候災害（如暴雨致災、都市熱島效應加劇），並探討調適策略與減緩方案。 6. 培養跨部門協作與決策能力：強化學生在政府、民間、學術與社區之間的協調溝通與合作能力，提升防災政策與行動方案的可行性與永續性。
課程綱要.授課內容:
課程內容主軸包括，
課程導論與都市防災概念：課程簡介、都市防災的重要性、都市脆弱性與韌性概念。
都市防災的核心元素：基礎設施韌性、社區參與、資源整合、制度與法規架
都市防災理論與架構（I）：韌性城市（Resilient City）、安全城市（Safe City）、永續城市（Sustainable City）。
都市防災理論與架構（II）：都市防災循環（預防–減災–應變–復原）、風險治理理論、社會資本與防災。。
都市災害特性－地震與地層下陷：都市市地震災害特性、建築脆弱性分析、地層下陷對基礎設施的威脅。
都市災害特性－颱風、洪水與都市淹水：氣候因子、排水系統限制、極端降雨與都市洪災。
都市災害特性－火災、熱浪與複合型災害：高密度都市火災風險、都市熱島效應與熱浪健康衝擊、複合型與連鎖災害案例。
國際都市防災趨勢（I）：仙台減災綱領（Sendai Framework）、聯合國永續發展目標（SDGs）與都市防災的連結。
國際都市防災趨勢（II）：C40城市氣候領導聯盟、國際都市韌性倡議（如100 Resilient Cities）。
氣候變遷對都市防災的衝擊：極端氣候事件趨勢、海平面上升、氣候變遷脆弱度與調適策略。
都市防災科技與創新應用：智慧感測網、GIS與災害模擬、大數據與AI在防災決策中的應用。
都市防災的跨部門合作與治理：政府、企業、NGO與社區協作模式；公私協力（PPP）案例分析。
都市防災案例研討與模擬演練：國內外重大都市災害案例分析、情境推演與決策討論。
專題報告與課程總結：學生分組報告都市防災規劃提案，課程回顧與未來研究方向。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1.《都市防災規劃》 — 吳宏明、陳信雄等著，詹氏書局 2.《都市防災規劃》 — 吳宏明、陳信雄等著，詹氏書局 3.《都市洪水風險管理》 — 李鴻源著，天下文化 4.《智慧防災：科技應用與創新治理》 — 林宗弘著，遠流出版
